description: A stereo switch that picks one of eight input pairs for a single output, stepped by a trigger or addressed by a voltage

params.text: Chooses whether the TRG/CV jack is read as triggers that step from one input to the next, or as a voltage that addresses an input directly
Sets how many of the eight inputs the cycle runs through, 1 to 8
Sets which way the selection moves on each trigger: down the column, at random, or up the column
Sets how long the crossfade between one input and the next takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant
Sets which input a reset jumps to, 1 to 8; it can be outside the range the INs selector cycles through

inputs.text: Steps or addresses the selection, depending on the TRG/CV switch: a trigger to step, or 0-10V spread across the inputs the INs selector covers
A trigger here jumps to the input the RST knob sets
The left channel of one of the eight sources; it reaches the output only while it is the selected one
The right channel of one of the eight sources; with nothing patched the left jack of that row is used for both

outputs.text: The left channel of the selected source, clamped to ±10V
The right channel of the selected source, clamped to ±10V

menu: Cycle — with this unticked the selection stops at the last input instead of wrapping round to the first
RST input = reverse advance — turns the RST jack into a backward step instead of a jump to the RST knob's input; with the direction set to random it gives a random input either way
Initialize on Start — starts from the input the RST knob sets when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming where it left off

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
